## Installation

Build the verified repository revision from source:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/aspose-pdf-foss/Aspose-PDF-FOSS-for-Go.git
cd Aspose-PDF-FOSS-for-Go
git checkout f05d5628e85d3e8eb31e9191ea4ce8297b1d0f69
mvn clean install
```

This path requires JDK Go 1.24++ and Maven. The source build and the minimal example
below were verified together at revision `f05d5628e85d3e8eb31e9191ea4ce8297b1d0f69`.
